Basic chat completion via the Anthropic provider (claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022) with system and user messages

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"max_tokens\":16,\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a helpful assistant.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"Say hello in one word.\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022\",\"temperature\":0}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.chat(_req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
debugPrint(result.model())
debugPrint(result.usage()?.totalTokens() as Any)
```
